title: EOIP Schema Catalog
description: Registry of all EOIP data contract schemas. Each entry maps a schema name to its metadata, domain, and lifecycle status. Used by contract tests, API documentation generators, and schema governance tooling.

schemas.name: Common Definitions
schemas.description: Reusable type definitions (canonical_id, confidence, timestamps, pagination, errors) shared via $ref.

schemas.name: Agent Request
schemas.description: Inbound agent task request with goal, budgets, dry-run, and recursion tracking.

schemas.name: Agent Result
schemas.description: Agent task completion envelope with outcome, evidence, and cost accounting.

schemas.name: API Contract
schemas.description: API endpoint contract definition for OpenAPI spec generation and contract testing.

schemas.name: Audit Event
schemas.description: Immutable audit trail event for compliance and governance tracking.

schemas.name: Behavioral Gate Verdict
schemas.description: CI merge-gate verdict with contract extraction, structured diffing, and abstain protocol.

schemas.name: Causal Hypothesis
schemas.description: Causal inference hypothesis with treatment/control populations and effect estimation.

schemas.name: Crawl Scope
schemas.description: Web/API crawler scope definition with URL patterns, depth limits, and exclusions.

schemas.name: Demo Scenario Pack
schemas.description: Enterprise demo scenario pack with journeys, personas, and expected outcomes.

schemas.name: Evidence
schemas.description: Evidence record linking assertions to verifiable source artifacts.

schemas.name: Graph Diff
schemas.description: Structural diff between two graph snapshots (vertex/edge additions, removals, modifications).

schemas.name: Graph Mutation
schemas.description: Single graph mutation operation (UPSERT or TOMBSTONE) for vertex or edge.

schemas.name: Graph Result
schemas.description: Standard graph query result envelope with vertices, edges, and metadata.

schemas.name: Graph Revision
schemas.description: Temporal revision record for graph versioning and bitemporal queries.

schemas.name: Incremental Index Event
schemas.description: Git hook-triggered incremental AST re-indexing with symbol impact propagation.

schemas.name: Knowledge Capsule
schemas.description: Self-contained knowledge export with traversal spec, entity/relationship counts, and security policy.

schemas.name: Knowledge Debt Finding
schemas.description: Knowledge debt finding with severity, remediation cost, and impacted entities.

schemas.name: Knowledge SLO
schemas.description: Knowledge service level objective with target, current value, and burn rate.

schemas.name: Memory Record
schemas.description: Agent memory record with TTL, provenance, confidence, and classification.

schemas.name: Multihop Query
schemas.description: Parallel multi-hop traversal with CSR acceleration, fraud ring detection, and partition strategies.

schemas.name: Mutation Stream Event
schemas.description: Real-time SSE/WebSocket mutation event with webhook delivery, HMAC signing, and DLQ tracking.

schemas.name: Named Graph Config
schemas.description: Per-tenant named-graph isolation with namespace prefixing, quotas, and cross-tenant policies.

schemas.name: Normalized Entity
schemas.description: Canonical normalized entity with creation status, confidence, and source references.

schemas.name: Normalized Relationship
schemas.description: Canonical normalized relationship between two entities.

schemas.name: Ontology Evolution Proposal
schemas.description: Proposal for ontology schema changes with impact analysis and migration assessment.

schemas.name: Ontology Induction Result
schemas.description: LLM-assisted ontology schema induction with SHACL validation and consolidation guard.

schemas.name: Process Event
schemas.description: Process lifecycle event for workflow and pipeline tracking.

schemas.name: Query Plan
schemas.description: Query execution plan with operator tree, cost estimates, and optimization hints.

schemas.name: Reconciliation Run
schemas.description: Reconciliation run tracking source/graph consistency with drift detection.

schemas.name: Relationship Revision
schemas.description: Temporal revision for relationship/edge versioning.

schemas.name: Retrieval Result
schemas.description: RAG retrieval result with ranked chunks, relevance scores, and evidence links.

schemas.name: Semantic Change Event
schemas.description: Semantic change detection event capturing meaning-level shifts in entities or relationships.

schemas.name: Simulation Spec
schemas.description: What-if simulation specification with base graph version and mutation sequence.

schemas.name: Source Capabilities
schemas.description: Source connector capability declaration (supported operations, rate limits, auth methods).

schemas.name: Source Checkpoint
schemas.description: Incremental sync checkpoint for resumable source ingestion.

schemas.name: Source Event v1
schemas.description: Immutable source event envelope with content-addressed payload hash.

schemas.name: Source Event v2
schemas.description: Extended source event with acquisition fabric metadata and provenance chain.

schemas.name: Source Registry Entry
schemas.description: Source system registration with connection details, scheduling, and health status.

schemas.name: Streaming Memory Event
schemas.description: Dual-timeline streaming memory with salience decay and conflict resolution.

schemas.name: Telemetry Evidence
schemas.description: Telemetry observation linked to graph entities for operational evidence.

schemas.name: Tool Request
schemas.description: Agent tool invocation request with risk level, approval tracking, and dry-run.

schemas.name: Tool Result
schemas.description: Agent tool execution result with output, errors, and cost tracking.

schemas.name: Uncertainty Envelope
schemas.description: Calibrated uncertainty scoring with evidence chains, coverage, staleness, and abstain protocol.

schemas.name: Vector Search Request
schemas.description: Unified vector+graph search with HNSW, hybrid RRF, and multi-strategy queries.

schemas.name: Warrant
schemas.description: Typed provenance, authority, validity, consequence and operator record shared by IP and ASPEII workstreams.
